verdict.rationale: Automatic image captioning is a fair question for a web-data API built for AI agents, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: returning images or screenshots in a scrape, and OCR for scanned PDFs. Nothing documents generating text captions or descriptions of page images for text-only models.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
